name: Flat Design
summary: Interfaces of solid colour fields, simple geometric shapes, bold sans-serif type and no gradients or shadows. It followed Microsoft Metro in 2010 and Windows 8 in 2012, and became the default after iOS 7 in 2013.

philosophy.core_thesis: A digital interface is honest when it shows itself as pixels and type, and does not imitate physical objects.
design_principles: Fill every surface with one solid colour and use no gradient, texture or shadow.
Build the palette from 4 to 6 saturated colours, such as turquoise, emerald, amethyst, carrot and alizarin, plus one neutral.
Draw icons as simple geometric shapes on a 24px or 32px square, with solid fills or a 2px stroke and no bevel.
Express hierarchy with size, weight and colour, using at least a 1.25 ratio between type levels.
Use large tap targets of at least 44px and generous padding of 16 to 24px around content.
Separate regions with a change of colour and not with a border, a shadow or a line.
Give interactive elements a plain colour change on hover and press, with no lift and no glow.
anti_patterns: Gradients, glossy highlights and reflections on buttons
Drop shadows, inner shadows and bevels on any element
Textures of leather, paper, wood or linen as backgrounds
Low-contrast pastel text under 4.5:1 on a coloured field
Ghost buttons with a 1px outline as the only primary action
Mixed icon styles of outline and filled in one view

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 30px gutters on the web and a 4-column grid with 16px margins on a phone; every spacing value is a multiple of 8px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35–50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left text with a shared left edge; icons centre in their containers; blocks of colour run full-width and bleed to the screen edge on mobile.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles and circles with a radius of 0px to 4px on buttons and cards, and 50% on avatars; tiles are squares or 2:1 rectangles.

font_pairings.note: A wide geometric face for headlines and a neutral text face; common in 2013 flat templates.
A single-family setting with weights 300 to 900, close to the Helvetica Neue Light used by iOS 7.
A thin elegant display face for large headings with a sturdy text face.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.01em to 0em; body stays at 0; upper-case labels take +0.05em.
hierarchy_rules: Use light (300) or regular (400) for large display text and bold (700) for buttons and labels.
Use four sizes, for example 14, 18, 32 and 64px, with a ratio near 1.8 between display levels.
Set headline text in white on a saturated colour field or in near-black on white.
Keep body text at 16px or more with a line length of 45 to 75 characters.

color.palette_structure: One white or light-grey base, 4 to 6 saturated flat colours, and one dark neutral; each section holds one dominant colour on 30 to 60% of its area.
color.contrast_rules: Body text holds at least 4.5:1; white text on Turquoise reaches only 2.5:1, so large text of 24px or more or a darker shade of #16A085 is required on that field.
color.surface_treatment: Opaque solid fills with no gradient, no noise and no transparency except for 50% overlays on photographs.
color.light_and_shadow: None. There is no light source; depth comes from overlap and from colour change.

materiality.surface_simulation: None; surfaces are plain screen colour and do not imitate any material.
materiality.border_rules: No borders on cards and buttons; inputs take a 2px solid bottom or full border in the accent colour when focused.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; box-shadow and backdrop-filter stay at none, and there is one flat layer.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid or 2px-stroke glyphs on a 24px grid with rounded or square terminals, one colour each, and no gradient.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Flat vector shapes in the palette with no outlines and no shading, or full-bleed photographs under a 50% colour overlay.
decorative_elements: long shadow of 45 degrees on icons in the 2013 variant

motion.transition_physics: Short plain transitions of colour, opacity and position with no overshoot; panels slide in from the edge by their own width.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover darkens the fill by 8 to 10% lightness; active darkens it by 15%; nothing lifts, scales more than 1.02 or glows.

emotion.target_response: Directness and lightness: the viewer feels that the interface is quick, honest and free of ornament.

avoid_when: The user must tell raised controls from plain content, because flat buttons lose the affordance cue.
The brand needs warmth, material richness or a premium feel.
The interface has many dense, equal-weight controls that need layers to show order.

modifiers.how: Add elevation shadows of 2 to 24dp with a top-left key light and keep the solid fills and the colour palette.
Add a 4 to 8% top-to-bottom gradient and a 1px highlight on controls; keep the layout and the colours.
Add flat illustrated people with exaggerated proportions and a 4-hue palette; keep the solid fills and the layout.
Reduce the palette to black, white and one accent; set text flush left on a 12-column grid with a single typeface.

pack.why: Solid glyphs with no depth and no detail: the form alone carries the meaning.

ground.why: Flat design uses solid blocks of colour; the long hard shadow gives depth with no gradient.
